chapter: Chick Webb, Lucky Roberts, Alex Jackson
title: Joining Chick Webb with Johnny Hodges in the band
summary: Scott joins Webb's new band, and lists the members.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: Well, I was getting more situated as far as -- I was known, and I knew -- I wasn't scuffling, you might say,
because I had made money and had a little bank account. And I was more or less secure and felt more secure, and I didn't mind working.

Now, in between, -- oh, yeah, Chick wanted me, and so I felt sorry for Chick, he was handicapped. He's a good little drummer, but he was handicapped. And he was trying to get a band together. And he talked so nice, he pleaded with me. And I didn't know, so I said no. But news travels around. So I went in with him. And you know who was in the band? Johnny Hodges.

Johnny Hodges was in the band before he went with Duke. He was in that band. He and Elmer Williams on sax. And Slats Slattery, Johnny Truehart was on guitar, Slats was on trombone, with me and Louis Bacon. And Chick on the drums. And Kirkpatrick was on piano, yeah, Kirk. Nice little band.
